primitives.meaning: a first-party submission: a form, a content request, a contact request, or an equivalent deliberate act
entryFilters: a first-party capture recorded with the context the person declared
a contact point the person gave in that capture
the permission position recorded as its own fact, separate from the submission
no instance of this journey is already open for the the individual capture and what it asked for
hard gates (GLB-31) allow communication for this purpose

primitives.asks: Is the destination they supplied actually usable for this?

branches.label: Usable
branches.test: the supplied destination is valid, deliverable and permitted for fulfilling what was asked for

branches.label: Not usable
branches.test: no valid deliverable destination was supplied, or it is not permitted for this fulfilment

primitives.asks: What did they ask for, given we cannot deliver to them?

branches.label: Asked for a person
branches.test: the request was for contact rather than for material

branches.label: Asked for the material
branches.test: the request was for something we would have sent, and there is nowhere to send it

primitives.state: captured with nothing deliverable; the request was not fulfilled
primitives.reEntry: a valid permitted destination, supplied later, makes the same request fulfillable

primitives.asks: What did the person actually declare?

branches.label: Asked for a person
branches.test: the capture states a request only a person can answer - a conversation, a price for their own situation, an assessment

branches.label: Asked for the material
branches.test: the capture asks for a document, an access or a notification and names no person-led request

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it

primitives.purpose: Send what they asked for and say that a person will follow up, naming when.
primitives.brief: Send what they asked for and say that a person will follow up, naming when. A promised follow-up with no time on it reads as a queue rather than an answer, and the person starts again elsewhere
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.on: a captured interest whose declared request can only be answered by a person
carries: what the person declared and asked for, in their own terms
what was already sent to them and when
the permission facts recorded, and what they do and do not cover

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it

primitives.purpose: Send exactly what the capture asked for, once, and nothing the person did not ask for alongside it.
primitives.brief: Send exactly what the capture asked for, once, and nothing the person did not ask for alongside it. Fulfilment travels on the request; everything past it travels on permission, and the two must not be posted together
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.asks: Is there permission to continue past fulfilment?

branches.label: Permitted
branches.test: a permission covering ongoing contact was given in the capture and recorded as its own fact

branches.label: Fulfilment only
branches.test: nothing beyond the single requested delivery was permitted

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it

primitives.purpose: Open a bounded sequence on the subject they declared, and state where it ends when it opens.
primitives.brief: Open a bounded sequence on the subject they declared, and state where it ends when it opens. A sequence with no stated end is a subscription nobody agreed to, and it is remembered as one

mustNotClaim: a sequence with no stated end

primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

cancelOn.meaning: the person does something that names where they are going: a reply, a request to talk, a purchase
the person withdraws the permission this communication runs on

primitives.reads: the the individual capture and what it asked for re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

branches.label: Readiness declared
branches.test: the person did something that names a destination they are now ready for

branches.label: Stopped
branches.test: the person withdrew permission or asked to stop

primitives.reEntry: a later capture carrying its own permission is a new instance; this one is never resumed
a later capture from the same person is its own instance with its own destination
a later capture that carries a permission opens the bounded path
